methods: nuisance span retains constants/collinear controls; exposure must identifiable; all columns standardized within context; no ligand-TF effects or p
scientific_limits: composition PCs are subtype mixture, not formal state

sameGSE different contexts not independent validations

acceptance: all candidate memberships and source-level summary separately recounted from original masks and private case arrays; design algebra independently checked before any effects published
